name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: SIGN-CHECKBOX-TRIGGER BUILD (v4, cleaned up), not for production: v0.4.22 confirmed working (root cause was lazy Experiment loading -- fixed there with a no-op ping() call). This build is a cleanup pass, not a behavior change: all setup (shutdown blocker, sign-checkbox hook) now lives in getAPI(), the documented lifecycle entry point, instead of bare module-level top-level code; the redundant toggleGlobalSignMessage monkey-patch is removed now that the id-matched "command" event listener alone is confirmed to catch both the toolbar button and the menu item (it was firing cleanup twice per toggle); and ping() is renamed to the more honestly-described activate().
